title: Umami Rich Saudi Arabian Fish Skillet
description: A malty and savory pescatarian dish featuring umeboshi, this Saudi Arabian fish skillet is a show-off recipe that combines the richness of umami flavors with the freshness of the sea, all emulsified to perfection and cooked to a bouncy qq texture in an iron teppan vessel.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan vessel over medium high heat to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the fish fillets with salt and black pepper.
Add olive oil to the preheated teppan and sear the fish fillets for 2 minutes on each side.
Remove the fish from the teppan and set aside.
Add more olive oil if necessary, then saute the minced garlic and grated ginger for 1 minute.
Add the umeboshi, malt syrup, and lemon juice to the teppan, stirring to emulsify.
Return the fish fillets to the teppan and spoon some of the umami rich sauce over the top of each fillet.
Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 5 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the fish hot, garnished with chopped scallions and a side of steamed vegetables.
Garnish with lemon wedges and serve immediately.
